sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca tvayā nāgapuraṃ gatvā sabhāyāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrajaḥ kim uktaḥ puṇḍarīkākṣa tan naḥ śaṃsitum arhasi
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: Having gone to the elephant city, O Lotus-eyed one, what did you say to the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra in the assembly? Please tell us all of it.

sanskrit: vāsudeva uvāca mayā nāgapuraṃ gatvā sabhāyāṃ dhṛtarāṣṭrajaḥ tathyaṃ pathyaṃ hitaṃ cokto na ca gṛhṇāti durmatiḥ
english: Vāsudeva said: Having gone to the elephant city, I spoke to the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra in the assembly words that were truthful, beneficial, and good — yet that wicked-minded one does not accept them.

sanskrit: yudhiṣṭhira uvāca tasminn utpatham āpanne kuruvṛddhaḥ pitāmahaḥ kim uktavān hṛṣīkeśa duryodhanam amarṣaṇam ācāryo vā mahābāho bhāradvājaḥ kim abravīt
english: Yudhiṣṭhira said: When that one had gone astray, O Hṛṣīkeśa, what did the elder of the Kurus, the grandsire, say? And what did the preceptor, the mighty-armed son of Bhāradvāja, say to the impatient Duryodhana?

sanskrit: pitā yavīyān asmākaṃ kṣattā dharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ putraśokābhisaṃtaptaḥ kim āha dhṛtarāṣṭrajam
english: And what did our younger father Vidura, the foremost among upholders of righteousness, afflicted with grief over his son, say to the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra?

sanskrit: kiṃ ca sarve nṛpatayaḥ sabhāyāṃ ye samāsate uktavanto yathātattvaṃ tad brūhi tvaṃ janārdana
english: And what did all the kings assembled in that hall say truthfully? Tell us all of this, O Janārdana.

sanskrit: uktavān hi bhavān sarvaṃ vacanaṃ kurumukhyayoḥ kāmalobhābhibhūtasya mandasya prājñamāninaḥ
english: For you have spoken everything to the two foremost of the Kurus — to that dull-witted one overwhelmed by desire and greed, who fancies himself wise.

sanskrit: apriyaṃ hṛdaye mahyaṃ tan na tiṣṭhati keśava teṣāṃ vākyāni govinda śrotum icchāmy ahaṃ vibho
english: That unpleasant news does not rest easy in my heart, O Keśava. I wish to hear their words, O Govinda, O lord.

sanskrit: yathā ca nābhipadyeta kālas tāta tathā kuru bhavān hi no gatiḥ kṛṣṇa bhavān nātho bhavān guruḥ
english: And do act, dear one, so that the critical moment does not arrive. You are our refuge, O Kṛṣṇa; you are our master; you are our guide.

sanskrit: vāsudeva uvāca śṛṇu rājan yathā vākyam ukto rājā suyodhanaḥ madhye kurūṇāṃ rājendra sabhāyāṃ tan nibodha me
english: Vāsudeva said: Listen, O king, to how King Suyodhana was addressed in the midst of the Kurus in the assembly. Hear it from me, O lord of kings.

sanskrit: mayā vai śrāvite vākye jahāsa dhṛtarāṣṭrajaḥ atha bhīṣmaḥ susaṃkruddha idaṃ vacanam abravīt
english: When my words were spoken, the son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra laughed. Then Bhīṣma, greatly enraged, spoke these words:

sanskrit: duryodhana nibodhedaṃ kulārthe yad bravīmi te tac chrutvā rājaśārdūla svakulasya hitaṃ kuru
english: "Duryodhana, understand what I say to you for the sake of your lineage. Having heard it, O tiger among kings, do what is beneficial for your own clan.

sanskrit: mama tāta pitā rājañ śaṃtanur lokaviśrutaḥ tasyāham eka evāsaṃ putraḥ putravatāṃ varaḥ
english: My father, dear boy, was King Śaṃtanu, renowned throughout the world. I was his sole son, the foremost among those who have sons.

sanskrit: tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā dvitīyaḥ syāt kathaṃ sutaḥ ekaputram aputraṃ vai pravadanti manīṣiṇaḥ
english: A thought arose in his mind: how might a second son come to be? For the wise declare that one with only one son is as good as sonless.

sanskrit: na cocchedaṃ kulaṃ yāyād vistīryeta kathaṃ yaśaḥ tasyāham īpsitaṃ buddhvā kālīṃ mātaram āvaham
english: And lest the line become extinct, and lest his fame cease to spread — understanding his wish, I brought Kālī as his mother.

sanskrit: pratijñāṃ duṣkarāṃ kṛtvā pitur arthe kulasya ca arājā cordhvaretāś ca yathā suviditaṃ tava pratīto nivasāmy eṣa pratijñām anupālayan
english: Having made a terrible vow for my father's sake and for the sake of the lineage — remaining celibate and kingless, as is well known to you — I have lived here faithfully, keeping that vow.

sanskrit: tasyāṃ jajñe mahābāhuḥ śrīmān kurukulodvahaḥ vicitravīryo dharmātmā kanīyān mama pārthivaḥ
english: From her was born the mighty-armed, glorious uplifter of the Kuru lineage — Vicitravīrya, righteous of soul, the younger king, my brother.

sanskrit: svaryāte 'haṃ pitari taṃ svarājye saṃnyaveśayam vicitravīryaṃ rājānaṃ bhṛtyo bhūtvā hy adhaścaraḥ
english: When my father had ascended to heaven, I installed King Vicitravīrya in his own kingdom, myself serving as a subordinate, walking humbly below.

sanskrit: tasyāhaṃ sadṛśān dārān rājendra samudāvaham jitvā pārthivasaṃghātam api te bahuśaḥ śrutam
english: I brought suitable wives for him, O lord of kings, having conquered an assembly of kings — this too you have heard many times.

sanskrit: tato rāmeṇa samare dvandvayuddham upāgamam sa hi rāmabhayād ebhir nāgarair vipravāsitaḥ dāreṣv atiprasaktaś ca yakṣmāṇaṃ samapadyata
english: Then I met Rāma in single combat on the battlefield. For being driven out by the inhabitants of that city through fear of Rāma, and being overly attached to his wives, Vicitravīrya contracted consumption.

sanskrit: yadā tv arājake rāṣṭre na vavarṣa sureśvaraḥ tadābhyadhāvan mām eva prajāḥ kṣudbhayapīḍitāḥ
english: When the lord of the gods did not rain upon the kingless realm, the subjects, tormented by hunger and fear, came rushing to me alone.

sanskrit: prajā ūcuḥ upakṣīṇāḥ prajāḥ sarvā rājā bhava bhavāya naḥ ītayo nuda bhadraṃ te śaṃtanoḥ kulavardhana
english: The subjects said: All the people are perishing. Become our king for our welfare. Drive away our afflictions. Good fortune to you, O increaser of Śaṃtanu's lineage.

sanskrit: pīḍyante te prajāḥ sarvā vyādhibhir bhṛśadāruṇaiḥ alpāvaśiṣṭā gāṅgeya tāḥ paritrātum arhasi
english: All those subjects are afflicted by greatly terrible diseases and are nearly spent. O son of the Gaṅgā, you must protect them.

sanskrit: vyādhīn praṇudya vīra tvaṃ prajā dharmeṇa pālaya tvayi jīvati mā rāṣṭraṃ vināśam upagacchatu
english: Drive away the diseases, O hero, and protect the subjects righteously. While you are alive, let not the kingdom come to ruin.

sanskrit: bhīṣma uvāca prajānāṃ krośatīnāṃ vai naivākṣubhyata me manaḥ pratijñāṃ rakṣamāṇasya sadvṛttaṃ smaratas tathā
english: Bhīṣma said: Even as the subjects were lamenting, my mind was not shaken — protecting my vow, and remembering likewise my good conduct.

sanskrit: tataḥ paurā mahārāja mātā kālī ca me śubhā bhṛtyāḥ purohitācāryā brāhmaṇāś ca bahuśrutāḥ mām ūcur bhṛśasaṃtaptā bhava rājeti saṃtatam
english: Then the citizens, O great king, and my auspicious mother Kālī, the servants, the chaplain, the teachers, and the greatly learned Brahmins, all deeply grieved, spoke to me repeatedly: 'Become king.'

sanskrit: pratīparakṣitaṃ rāṣṭraṃ tvāṃ prāpya vinaśiṣyati sa tvam asmaddhitārthaṃ vai rājā bhava mahāmate
english: 'The kingdom protected by Pratīpa will perish now that it has come to you. For our welfare, become king, O great-minded one.'

sanskrit: ity uktaḥ prāñjalir bhūtvā duḥkhito bhṛśam āturaḥ tebhyo nyavedayaṃ putra pratijñāṃ pitṛgauravāt ūrdhvaretā hy arājā ca kulasyārthe punaḥ punaḥ
english: Thus addressed, I folded my hands, deeply grieved and distressed. Out of reverence for my father, I declared my vow to them repeatedly — that I was celibate and without kingship, for the sake of the lineage.

sanskrit: tato 'haṃ prāñjalir bhūtvā mātaraṃ saṃprasādayam nāmba śaṃtanunā jātaḥ kauravaṃ vaṃśam udvahan pratijñāṃ vitathāṃ kuryām iti rājan punaḥ punaḥ
english: Then, with folded hands, I appeased my mother, saying: 'No, mother — I, born of Śaṃtanu and bearing up the Kaurava lineage, would never make my vow false' — thus, O king, again and again.

sanskrit: viśeṣatas tvadarthaṃ ca dhuri mā māṃ niyojaya ahaṃ preṣyaś ca dāsaś ca tavāmba sutavatsale
english: 'And especially for your sake — do not yoke me to this burden. I am your servant and your slave, O mother who loves your son.'

sanskrit: evaṃ tām anunīyāhaṃ mātaraṃ janam eva ca ayācaṃ bhrātṛdāreṣu tadā vyāsaṃ mahāmunim
english: Having thus appeased my mother and the people, I then besought the great sage Vyāsa regarding wives for my brothers.

sanskrit: saha mātrā mahārāja prasādya tam ṛṣiṃ tadā apatyārtham ayācaṃ vai prasādaṃ kṛtavāṃś ca saḥ trīn sa putrān ajanayat tadā bharatasattama
english: Together with my mother, O great king, having propitiated that sage, I begged him for offspring. He granted the grace, and he then fathered three sons, O best of the Bhāratas.

sanskrit: andhaḥ karaṇahīneti na vai rājā pitā tava rājā tu pāṇḍur abhavan mahātmā lokaviśrutaḥ
english: Because he was blind and lacking faculties, your father was not king. Rather, the great-souled Pāṇḍu became king, renowned throughout the world.

sanskrit: sa rājā tasya te putrāḥ pitur dāyādyahāriṇaḥ mā tāta kalahaṃ kārṣī rājyasyārdhaṃ pradīyatām
english: He was the king, and his sons — your cousins — are the heirs to their father's inheritance. Do not quarrel, dear boy; let half the kingdom be given to them.

sanskrit: mayi jīvati rājyaṃ kaḥ saṃpraśāset pumān iha māvamaṃsthā vaco mahyaṃ śamam icchāmi vaḥ sadā
english: While I still live, what man should rule the kingdom here? Do not disregard my words. I always desire peace for you all.

sanskrit: na viśeṣo 'sti me putra tvayi teṣu ca pārthiva matam etat pitus tubhyaṃ gāndhāryā vidurasya ca
english: There is no distinction for me between you and them, O king, my son. This is the view of your father, of Gāndhārī, and of Vidura.

sanskrit: śrotavyaṃ yadi vṛddhānāṃ mātiśaṅkīr vaco mama nāśayiṣyasi mā sarvam ātmānaṃ pṛthivīṃ tathā
english: If the words of elders are to be heeded, do not be suspicious of my counsel. You will not destroy everything — yourself and the earth alike."

sanskrit: vāsudeva uvāca bhīṣmeṇokte tato droṇo duryodhanam abhāṣata madhye nṛpāṇāṃ bhadraṃ te vacanaṃ vacanakṣamaḥ
english: Vāsudeva said: After Bhīṣma had spoken, Droṇa then addressed Duryodhana in the midst of the kings — he who was capable of speech spoke words of good counsel:

sanskrit: prātīpaḥ śaṃtanus tāta kulasyārthe yathotthitaḥ tathā devavrato bhīṣmaḥ kulasyārthe sthito 'bhavat
english: "Just as Prātīpa's son Śaṃtanu arose for the sake of his lineage, so too Devavrata Bhīṣma stood firm for the sake of the lineage.

sanskrit: tataḥ pāṇḍur narapatiḥ satyasaṃdho jitendriyaḥ rājā kurūṇāṃ dharmātmā suvrataḥ susamāhitaḥ
english: Then Pāṇḍu, the lord of men, true to his word, master of his senses, the king of the Kurus, righteous in soul, of noble vows, and composed of mind —

sanskrit: jyeṣṭhāya rājyam adadād dhṛtarāṣṭrāya dhīmate yavīyasas tathā kṣattuḥ kuruvaṃśavivardhanaḥ
english: — that increaser of the Kuru lineage gave the kingdom to the elder Dhṛtarāṣṭra, the wise one, and likewise acknowledged the younger Vidura.

sanskrit: tataḥ siṃhāsane rājan sthāpayitvainam acyutam vanaṃ jagāma kauravyo bhāryābhyāṃ sahito 'nagha
english: Then, O king, having installed that unfailing one upon the lion-throne, the Kaurava prince departed to the forest together with his two wives, O sinless one.

sanskrit: nīcaiḥ sthitvā tu vidura upāste sma vinītavat preṣyavat puruṣavyāghro vālavyajanam utkṣipan
english: And Vidura, that tiger among men, stood humbly in a low place attending like a servant, waving the yak-tail fan.

sanskrit: tataḥ sarvāḥ prajās tāta dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ janeśvaram anvapadyanta vidhivad yathā pāṇḍuṃ narādhipam
english: Then all the subjects, dear boy, followed Dhṛtarāṣṭra as their lord of men, duly, just as they had followed Pāṇḍu, the ruler of men.

sanskrit: visṛjya dhṛtarāṣṭrāya rājyaṃ sa vidurāya ca cacāra pṛthivīṃ pāṇḍuḥ sarvāṃ parapuraṃjayaḥ
english: Having handed the kingdom over to Dhṛtarāṣṭra and Vidura, Pāṇḍu, the conqueror of enemy cities, ranged over the entire earth.

sanskrit: kośasaṃjanane dāne bhṛtyānāṃ cānvavekṣaṇe bharaṇe caiva sarvasya viduraḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ
english: In building up the treasury, in giving gifts, in overseeing the servants, and in maintaining everything — Vidura, true to his word, took charge.

sanskrit: saṃdhivigrahasaṃyukto rājñaḥ saṃvāhanakriyāḥ avaikṣata mahātejā bhīṣmaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ
english: Bhīṣma, of great splendor and conqueror of enemy cities, superintended the matters of peace and war and attended to the affairs of the king.

sanskrit: siṃhāsanastho nṛpatir dhṛtarāṣṭro mahābalaḥ anvāsyamānaḥ satataṃ vidureṇa mahātmanā
english: King Dhṛtarāṣṭra of great might sat upon the lion-throne, constantly attended upon by the great-souled Vidura.

sanskrit: kathaṃ tasya kule jātaḥ kulabhedaṃ vyavasyasi saṃbhūya bhrātṛbhiḥ sārdhaṃ bhuṅkṣva bhogāñ janādhipa
english: Being born in that lineage, how do you resolve to divide it? Unite with your brothers and enjoy your pleasures together, O lord of the people.

sanskrit: bravīmy ahaṃ na kārpaṇyān nārthahetoḥ kathaṃ cana bhīṣmeṇa dattam aśnāmi na tvayā rājasattama
english: I say this not out of pity, nor for any material reason whatsoever. I eat what is given by Bhīṣma, not by you, O best of kings.

sanskrit: nāhaṃ tvatto 'bhikāṅkṣiṣye vṛttyupāyaṃ janādhipa yato bhīṣmas tato droṇo yad bhīṣmas tv āha tat kuru
english: I shall not seek from you any means of livelihood, O lord of the people. Where Bhīṣma is, there is Droṇa. Do what Bhīṣma has said.

sanskrit: dīyatāṃ pāṇḍuputrebhyo rājyārdham arikarśana samam ācāryakaṃ tāta tava teṣāṃ ca me sadā
english: Let half the kingdom be given to the sons of Pāṇḍu, O scourge of enemies. My preceptorship is equal to both you and them at all times, dear boy.

sanskrit: aśvatthāmā yathā mahyaṃ tathā śvetahayo mama bahunā kiṃ pralāpena yato dharmas tato jayaḥ
english: As Aśvatthāmā is to me, so too is the white-horsed Arjuna to me. What need is there for much talk? Where there is dharma, there is victory."

sanskrit: evam ukte mahārāja droṇenāmitatejasā vyājahāra tato vākyaṃ viduraḥ satyasaṃgaraḥ pitur vadanam anvīkṣya parivṛtya ca dharmavit
english: When the immeasurably splendid Droṇa had thus spoken, O great king, Vidura, true to his word and knower of dharma, turning and looking at his father's face, then spoke these words:

sanskrit: devavrata nibodhedaṃ vacanaṃ mama bhāṣataḥ pranaṣṭaḥ kauravo vaṃśas tvayāyaṃ punar uddhṛtaḥ
english: "Devavrata, hear these words I speak: the Kaurava lineage had been all but lost, and you raised it up again.

sanskrit: tan me vilapamānasya vacanaṃ samupekṣase ko 'yaṃ duryodhano nāma kule 'smin kulapāṃsanaḥ
english: Yet you disregard my lamentation's words. Who is this Duryodhana, this defiler of the clan, in this lineage?

sanskrit: yasya lobhābhibhūtasya matiṃ samanuvartase anāryasyākṛtajñasya lobhopahatacetasaḥ atikrāmati yaḥ śāstraṃ pitur dharmārthadarśinaḥ
english: You follow the will of one overwhelmed by greed, ignoble and ungrateful, whose mind is destroyed by greed — one who transgresses the counsel of his father who sees dharma and artha.

sanskrit: ete naśyanti kuravo duryodhanakṛtena vai yathā te na praṇaśyeyur mahārāja tathā kuru
english: These Kurus are perishing through what Duryodhana has done. O great king, act so that they do not perish.

sanskrit: māṃ caiva dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ ca pūrvam eva mahādyute citrakāra ivālekhyaṃ kṛtvā mā sma vināśaya prajāpatiḥ prajāḥ sṛṣṭvā yathā saṃharate tathā
english: Having made me and Dhṛtarāṣṭra as mere paintings at the outset, O greatly radiant one, do not destroy us. As Prajāpati, having created beings, withdraws them, so too would you.

sanskrit: nopekṣasva mahābāho paśyamānaḥ kulakṣayam atha te 'dya matir naṣṭā vināśe pratyupasthite vanaṃ gaccha mayā sārdhaṃ dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa caiva ha
english: Do not be indifferent, O mighty-armed one, seeing the destruction of the lineage. Or if your mind is now lost, with ruin at hand, then go to the forest together with me and with Dhṛtarāṣṭra.

sanskrit: baddhvā vā nikṛtiprajñaṃ dhārtarāṣṭraṃ sudurmatim sādhv idaṃ rājyam adyāstu pāṇḍavair abhirakṣitam
english: Or else, having bound up that wicked-minded son of Dhṛtarāṣṭra of treacherous intellect, let this kingdom now be well protected by the Pāṇḍavas.

sanskrit: prasīda rājaśārdūla vināśo dṛśyate mahān pāṇḍavānāṃ kurūṇāṃ ca rājñāṃ cāmitatejasām
english: Be gracious, O tiger among kings. Great destruction is foreseen — of the Pāṇḍavas, the Kurus, and kings of immeasurable splendor."

sanskrit: virarāmaivam uktvā tu viduro dīnamānasaḥ pradhyāyamānaḥ sa tadā niḥśvasaṃś ca punaḥ punaḥ
english: Having spoken thus, Vidura fell silent, his mind despondent, brooding, and sighing again and again.

sanskrit: tato 'tha rājñaḥ subalasya putrī; dharmārthayuktaṃ kulanāśabhītā duryodhanaṃ pāpamatiṃ nṛśaṃsaṃ; rājñāṃ samakṣaṃ sutam āha kopāt
english: Then the daughter of King Subala, fearful of the destruction of the lineage and speaking in accordance with dharma and artha, addressed in anger her wicked-minded and cruel son Duryodhana in the presence of the kings:

sanskrit: ye pārthivā rājasabhāṃ praviṣṭā; brahmarṣayo ye ca sabhāsado 'nye śṛṇvantu vakṣyāmi tavāparādhaṃ; pāpasya sāmātyaparicchadasya
english: "Let all the kings who have entered this royal assembly, and the brahmin seers and other members of the assembly, hear — I shall speak of the transgression of this sinful one along with his ministers and entourage.

sanskrit: rājyaṃ kurūṇām anupūrvabhogyaṃ; kramāgato naḥ kuladharma eṣaḥ tvaṃ pāpabuddhe 'tinṛśaṃsakarman; rājyaṃ kurūṇām anayād vihaṃsi
english: The kingdom of the Kurus is to be enjoyed in proper succession — this is our lineage's custom handed down in order. You of wicked mind and extremely cruel deeds are unjustly destroying the Kurus' kingdom.

sanskrit: rājye sthito dhṛtarāṣṭro manīṣī; tasyānujo viduro dīrghadarśī etāv atikramya kathaṃ nṛpatvaṃ; duryodhana prārthayase 'dya mohāt
english: Dhṛtarāṣṭra the wise stands in the kingdom; his younger brother Vidura is far-sighted. Passing over these two, how do you today out of delusion seek kingship, Duryodhana?

sanskrit: rājā ca kṣattā ca mahānubhāvau; bhīṣme sthite paravantau bhavetām ayaṃ tu dharmajñatayā mahātmā; na rājyakāmo nṛvaro nadījaḥ
english: Both the king and Vidura, those of great majesty, would be subservient while Bhīṣma stands. Yet that great-souled best of men, the river-born, desires no kingdom through his knowledge of dharma.

sanskrit: rājyaṃ tu pāṇḍor idam apradhṛṣyaṃ; tasyādya putrāḥ prabhavanti nānye rājyaṃ tad etan nikhilaṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ; paitāmahaṃ putrapautrānugāmi
english: This kingdom of Pāṇḍu is inviolable; his sons alone are the lords of it today, none others. That entire kingdom belongs to the Pāṇḍavas, the ancestral inheritance passing to sons and grandsons.

sanskrit: yad vai brūte kurumukhyo mahātmā; devavrataḥ satyasaṃdho manīṣī sarvaṃ tad asmābhir ahatya dharmaṃ; grāhyaṃ svadharmaṃ paripālayadbhiḥ
english: Whatever the great-souled foremost of the Kurus, Devavrata, true to his word and wise, has said — all of that is to be accepted by us, laying aside other dharma, while upholding our own dharma.

sanskrit: anujñayā cātha mahāvratasya; brūyān nṛpo yad viduras tathaiva kāryaṃ bhavet tat suhṛdbhir niyujya; dharmaṃ puraskṛtya sudīrghakālam
english: And whatever the king Vidura would say with the permission of that great-vowed one — that too should be done, appointed by friends, placing dharma foremost, for a very long time.

sanskrit: nyāyāgataṃ rājyam idaṃ kurūṇāṃ; yudhiṣṭhiraḥ śāstu vai dharmaputraḥ pracodito dhṛtarāṣṭreṇa rājñā; puraskṛtaḥ śāṃtanavena caiva
english: Let Yudhiṣṭhira, the son of Dharma, rule this kingdom of the Kurus which has come to him by right — urged on by King Dhṛtarāṣṭra and honored also by the son of Śaṃtanu."

sanskrit: vāsudeva uvāca evam ukte tu gāndhāryā dhṛtarāṣṭro janeśvaraḥ duryodhanam uvācedaṃ nṛpamadhye janādhipa
english: Vāsudeva said: When Gāndhārī had spoken thus, Dhṛtarāṣṭra, the lord of men, addressed Duryodhana with these words in the midst of the kings, O lord of the people:

sanskrit: duryodhana nibodhedaṃ yat tvāṃ vakṣyāmi putraka tathā tat kuru bhadraṃ te yady asti pitṛgauravam
english: "Duryodhana, understand what I shall say to you, dear son. Do accordingly — good fortune to you — if you have reverence for your father.

sanskrit: somaḥ prajāpatiḥ pūrvaṃ kurūṇāṃ vaṃśavardhanaḥ somād babhūva ṣaṣṭho vai yayātir nahuṣātmajaḥ
english: Soma the Prajāpati was the primordial increaser of the Kuru lineage. From Soma in the sixth generation was born Yayāti, the son of Nahuṣa.

sanskrit: tasya putrā babhūvuś ca pañca rājarṣisattamāḥ teṣāṃ yadur mahātejā jyeṣṭhaḥ samabhavat prabhuḥ
english: He had five sons, the best of royal sages. Among them, the mighty-souled Yadu became the eldest and the lord.

sanskrit: pūrur yavīyāṃś ca tato yo 'smākaṃ vaṃśavardhanaḥ śarmiṣṭhāyāḥ saṃprasūto duhitur vṛṣaparvaṇaḥ
english: And then there was Pūru, the younger, who is the increaser of our lineage, born of Śarmiṣṭhā, daughter of Vṛṣaparvan.

sanskrit: yaduś ca bharataśreṣṭha devayānyāḥ suto 'bhavat dauhitras tāta śukrasya kāvyasyāmitatejasaḥ
english: And Yadu, O best of the Bhāratas, was the son of Devayānī, the grandson of Śukra Kāvya of immeasurable splendor, dear boy.

sanskrit: yādavānāṃ kulakaro balavān vīryasaṃmataḥ avamene sa tu kṣatraṃ darpapūrṇaḥ sumandadhīḥ
english: He, the founder of the Yādava lineage, was mighty and esteemed for his valor. But filled with pride and of very dull wit, he disrespected the warrior class.

sanskrit: na cātiṣṭhat pituḥ śāstre baladarpavimohitaḥ avamene ca pitaraṃ bhrātṝṃś cāpy aparājitaḥ
english: Deluded by pride in his strength, he did not abide by his father's instruction. He also disrespected his father and his brothers — that undefeated one.

sanskrit: pṛthivyāṃ caturantāyāṃ yadur evābhavad balī vaśe kṛtvā sa nṛpatīn avasan nāgasāhvaye
english: Yadu alone became the mighty one on the earth bounded by the four horizons. Having subjugated the kings, he dwelt in the city named after the elephant.
